implementation: Allow existing settings radio groups to wrap within their container and let their option row grow vertically. Fixed-width radio cards, accessible names, roles, orientation and selection handlers are unchanged. Shared styles also address the same overflow pattern in Alignment.
validationRecovery: Old Reader retained stale CSS despite hot compilation. First authorized sample reopen timed out. Restarted npm run start:dev:quick, then retried the sample reopen to load fresh assets. Capture00 is historical stale-window evidence; repair captures start01 in a fresh Reader.

checks.status: Columns clipping fixed in sampled Reader; native NVDA verified
checks.observation: Columns choices wrap into the available docked-panel width. The complete 2 cols card and focus outline are visible after pointer selection, with no horizontal panel shift. NVDA identifies the named radio and checked state; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move selection between 1 col and 2 cols. All three modal choices fit in one row; Default selection and its focus outline were verified.
checks.limitations: Sampled English EPUB Reader right-docked settings and modal layout only; screenshot visibility and native NVDA diagnostic text checked. Speech not assessed acoustically. Home scrolled the browse viewport and is not passed as radio selection. Actual publication two-page spreads, other locales/formats and full WCAG conformance remain unverified.
